title.zh: 卷54 志二十九 地理一 直隶
title.raw: 卷54 志二十九 地理一 直隶

sentences.zh: =志二十九= 地理一 直隸 ：禹貢冀、兗二州之域。

translations.literal: Treatise 29, Geography 1, Zhili: the territory of the Ji and Yan provinces in the Yugong.
translations.idiomatic: Treatise 29, Geography 1 — Zhili: the domain of the Ji and Yan regions described in the Yugong.

sentences.zh: 明為北京，置北平布政使司、萬全都指揮使司。

translations.literal: Under the Ming it was Beijing; the Beiping Provincial Administration Commission and the Wanquan Capital Guard Command were established.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming it served as Beijing, with a Beiping provincial administration commission and the Wanquan capital guard command.

sentences.zh: 清順治初，定鼎京師，為直隸省。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Qing Shunzhi reign, the capital was fixed at the imperial capital and it became Zhili Province.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Shunzhi reign the Qing fixed the capital at the imperial city and made the region Zhili Province.

translations.literal: One governor-general was appointed, called Xuanda.
translations.idiomatic: One governor-general was installed, titled Xuanda (Xuanfu–Datong).

translations.literal: (Stationed at Datong in Shanxi; jurisdiction over Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: (Headquartered at Datong in Shanxi, with jurisdiction over Xuanfu.

translations.literal: Abolished in the thirteenth year of Shunzhi.)
translations.idiomatic: It was abolished in Shunzhi year 13.)

sentences.zh: 巡撫三：曰順天，（駐遵化，轄順天、永平二府。

translations.literal: Three governors: namely Shuntian, (stationed at Zunhua, governing Shuntian and Yongping prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Three governors were appointed: Shuntian (based at Zunhua, governing Shuntian and Yongping prefectures.

translations.literal: Abolished at the beginning of Kangxi.)
translations.idiomatic: Abolished at the beginning of the Kangxi reign.)

sentences.zh: 曰保定，（駐真定，轄保定、真定、順德、廣平、大名、河間六府。

translations.literal: called Baoding, (stationed at Zhending, governing six prefectures: Baoding, Zhending, Shunde, Guangping, Daming, and Hejian.
translations.idiomatic: Baoding (based at Zhending, governing Baoding, Zhending, Shunde, Guangping, Daming, and Hejian.

translations.literal: Abolished in the sixteenth year of Shunzhi.)
translations.idiomatic: Abolished in Shunzhi year 16.)

translations.literal: called Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanfu

translations.literal: (Stationed at Xuanfu garrison, governing Yanqing and Bao'an subprefectures.
translations.idiomatic: (based at Xuanfu garrison, governing Yanqing and Bao'an.

translations.literal: Abolished in the eighth year of Shunzhi.)
translations.idiomatic: Abolished in Shunzhi year 8.

sentences.zh: 五年，置直隸、山東、河南三省總督。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, the governor-general of the three provinces Zhili, Shandong, and Henan was established.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 a governor-general for Zhili, Shandong, and Henan was created.

translations.literal: (Stationed at Daming.)
translations.idiomatic: (He was stationed at Daming)

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, changed to Governor of Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: and in year 16 the post was changed to Governor of Zhili.

translations.literal: (The next year moved headquarters to Zhending.)
translations.idiomatic: (The following year the seat moved to Zhending)

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Kangxi, moved again to Baoding.
translations.idiomatic: and in Kangxi year 8 it moved again to Baoding.

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongzheng, again changed to governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng year 2 the office was again made governor-general.

sentences.zh: 而府尹舊治順天，為定制。

translations.literal: The Intendant's old jurisdiction remained Shuntian, as a fixed regulation.
translations.idiomatic: The metropolitan intendant's traditional jurisdiction remained Shuntian, by established custom.

sentences.zh: （先是順治十八年增置直隸總督，亦駐大名。

translations.literal: (Previously, in the eighteenth year of Shunzhi a Zhili governor-general was added, also stationed at Daming.
translations.idiomatic: (Earlier, in Shunzhi year 18 a Zhili governor-general had been added, likewise stationed at Daming.

sentences.zh: 康熙五年改三省總督，八年裁。）

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Kangxi changed to governor of the three provinces; abolished in the eighth year.)
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi year 5 it became the three-province governor-general and was abolished in year 8.)

sentences.zh: 康熙三十二年，改宣府鎮為宣化府。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year of Kangxi, Xuanfu garrison was changed to Xuanhua prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi year 32 Xuanfu garrison was converted into Xuanhua prefecture.

translations.literal: (Yanqing and Bao'an subprefectures were demoted and placed under it.)
translations.idiomatic: (Yanqing and Bao'an were reduced in rank and placed under it.)

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，置熱河廳，改真定為正定。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng, Rehe subprefecture was established; Zhending was renamed Zhengding.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yongzheng Rehe subprefecture was created and Zhending was renamed Zhengding.

sentences.zh: 二年，增置定、冀、晉、趙、深五直隸州，張家口廳。

translations.literal: In the second year, five directly governed prefectures Ding, Ji, Jin, Zhao, and Shen were added, and Zhangjiakou subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In year 2 five directly governed prefectures—Ding, Ji, Jin, Zhao, and Shen—were added, along with Zhangjiakou subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 三年，升天津衛為直隸州，九年為府。

translations.literal: In the third year, Tianjin guard was promoted to directly governed prefecture; in the ninth year to prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3 Tianjin guard was raised to a directly governed prefecture and in year 9 to a full prefecture.

translations.literal: In the tenth year, Duolun subprefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: In year 10 Duolunor subprefecture was established.

sentences.zh: 十一年，熱河廳、易州並為直隸州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Rehe subprefecture and Yizhou were both made directly governed prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 both Rehe subprefecture and Yizhou were made directly governed prefectures.

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, Dushikou subprefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: In year 12 Dushikou subprefecture was created.

translations.literal: (Jin subprefecture was demoted and placed under Zhengding.)
translations.idiomatic: (Jin subprefecture was demoted and subordinated to Zhengding.)

sentences.zh: 乾隆七年，承德仍為熱河廳。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Qianlong, Chengde was again made Rehe subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong year 7 Chengde was again reduced to Rehe subprefecture.

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Zunhua was promoted to directly governed prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 Zunhua was promoted to a directly governed prefecture.

sentences.zh: 四十三年，復升熱河廳為承德府。

translations.literal: In the forty-third year, Rehe subprefecture was again promoted to Chengde prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In year 43 Rehe subprefecture was again raised to Chengde prefecture.

translations.literal: In the second year of Guangxu, Weichang subprefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu year 2 Weichang subprefecture was established.

translations.literal: (Placed under Chengde.)
translations.idiomatic: (It was placed under Chengde.)

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, Chaoyang prefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: In year 30 Chaoyang prefecture was created.

translations.literal: (The next year Jianping was established and placed under it.)
translations.idiomatic: (The next year Jianping was established and subordinated to it.)

sentences.zh: 三十三年，升赤峰縣為直隸州。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year, Chifeng county was promoted to directly governed prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In year 33 Chifeng county was promoted to a directly governed prefecture.

translations.literal: (Kailu and three other counties were established and placed under it.)
translations.idiomatic: (Kailu and three other counties were created and placed under it.)

sentences.zh: 今京尹而外，領府十一，直隸州七，直隸廳三，散州九，散廳一，縣百有四。

translations.literal: At present, besides the metropolitan Intendant, it governs eleven prefectures, seven directly governed prefectures, three directly governed subprefectures, nine subordinate prefectures, one subordinate subprefecture, and one hundred four counties.
translations.idiomatic: Today, apart from the metropolitan intendant, the province contains eleven prefectures, seven directly governed prefectures, three directly governed subprefectures, nine ordinary prefectures, one ordinary subprefecture, and 104 counties.

sentences.zh: 北至內蒙古阿巴噶右翼旗界；

translations.literal: North to the border of the Right Wing of Abag Banner in Inner Mongolia;
translations.idiomatic: On the north it reaches the border of the Right Wing Abag Banner in Inner Mongolia;

East to the border of Ningyuan subprefecture in Fengtian;
translations.idiomatic: On the east to the border of Ningyuan subprefecture in Fengtian;

translations.literal: (Six hundred eighty li.)
South to the border of Lanfeng county in Henan;
translations.idiomatic: On the south to the border of Lanfeng county in Henan;

translations.literal: (One thousand four hundred thirty li.)
West to the border of Guangning county in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On the west to the border of Guangning county in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 廣一千二百三十里，袤二千六百三十里。

translations.literal: It measures one thousand two hundred thirty li in breadth and two thousand six hundred thirty li in length.
translations.idiomatic: It spans 1,230 li east to west and 2,630 li north to south.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年，編戶共四百九十九萬五千四百九十五，口二千三百六十一萬三千一百七十一。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xuantong, registered households totaled four million nine hundred ninety-five thousand four hundred ninety-five, and population twenty-three million six hundred thirteen thousand one hundred seventy-one.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong year 3 there were 4,995,495 registered households and a population of 23,613,171.

translations.literal: (Its mountains: Mount Heng and the Taihang range.
translations.idiomatic: (Its mountains include Mount Heng and the Taihang range.

sentences.zh: 其川：桑乾即永定、滹沱即子牙、衛、易、漳、白、灤。

translations.literal: Its rivers: the Sanggan, that is the Yongding; the Hutuo, that is the Ziya; the Wei, Yi, Zhang, Bai, and Luan.
translations.idiomatic: Its rivers are the Sanggan (Yongding), the Hutuo (Ziya), and the Wei, Yi, Zhang, Bai, and Luan.

sentences.zh: 其重險：井陘、山海、居庸、紫荊、倒馬諸關，喜峰、古北、獨石、張家諸口。

translations.literal: Its major passes: Jingxing, Shanhai, Juyong, Zijing, and Daoma passes; Xifeng, Gubei, Dushi, and Zhangjia openings.
translations.idiomatic: Its chief strategic barriers are the passes at Jingxing, Shanhai, Juyong, Zijing, and Daoma, and the gates at Xifeng, Gubei, Dushi, and Zhangjia.

sentences.zh: 交通則航路：自天津東南通之罘、上海，東北營口，東朝鮮仁川、日本長崎。

translations.literal: For transport, shipping routes: from Tianjin southeast to Zhifu and Shanghai, northeast to Yingkou, east to Inchon in Korea and Nagasaki in Japan.
translations.idiomatic: For transport, sea routes run from Tianjin southeast to Zhifu and Shanghai, northeast to Yingkou, and east to Inchon in Korea and Nagasaki in Japan.

sentences.zh: 鐵路：京津，津榆，京漢，正太，京張。

translations.literal: Railways: Jing-Jin, Jin-Yu, Jing-Han, Zheng-Tai, and Jing-Zhang.
translations.idiomatic: Railways include the Beijing–Tianjin, Tianjin–Yuyang, Beijing–Hankou, Zhengding–Taiyuan, and Beijing–Zhangjiakou lines.

sentences.zh: 郵道：東出山海關達盛京綏中，西出紫荊關達山西靈丘，南涉平原達山東德州，北出古北口達熱河。

translations.literal: Postal routes: east out of Shanhaiguan to Suizhong in Shengjing; west out of Zijing Pass to Lingqiu in Shanxi; south across the plain to Dezhou in Shandong; north out of Gubeikou to Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: Postal roads run east through Shanhaiguan to Suizhong in Shengjing, west through Zijing Pass to Lingqiu in Shanxi, south across the plain to Dezhou in Shandong, and north through Gubeikou to Rehe.

sentences.zh: 電線：西北通庫倫，西南通太原；

translations.literal: Telegraph lines: northwest to Urga, southwest to Taiyuan;
translations.idiomatic: Telegraph lines run northwest to Urga and southwest to Taiyuan;

translations.literal: from Tianjin northeast to Fengtian;
translations.idiomatic: from Tianjin northeast to Fengtian;

translations.literal: a submarine cable from Dagu east to Zhifu.)
translations.idiomatic: and a submarine cable from Dagu east to Zhifu.)

translations.literal: Shuntian: (In the early Ming it was called Beiping Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Shuntian Prefecture: (In the early Ming it was called Beiping Prefecture.

translations.literal: Later Beijing was built and the name was changed again.
translations.idiomatic: After the capital was built at Beijing the name was changed again.

translations.literal: Since the Liao dynasty all have made their capital here.)
translations.idiomatic: Since the Liao, every dynasty has made this its capital.

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Zhengtong, it was first fixed as called Jingshi (the Capital).
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong year 6 it was formally fixed as the Capital.)

translations.literal: It governed six subprefectures and twenty-five counties.
translations.idiomatic: It governed six subprefectures and twenty-five counties.

sentences.zh: 順治初，京師置府尹、府丞、治中。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shunzhi, the capital had an Intendant, Vice Intendant, and Administrative Magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Shunzhi the capital was given an intendant, vice intendant, and administrative magistrate.

sentences.zh: 其順天巡撫駐遵化，康熙初裁。

translations.literal: Its Shuntian governor was stationed at Zunhua; abolished at the beginning of Kangxi.
translations.idiomatic: The Shuntian governor was based at Zunhua and was abolished early in Kangxi.

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, Zunhua was promoted to subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In year 15 Zunhua was promoted to subprefecture rank.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，置四路同知，分轄所屬州、縣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, four circuit subprefects were appointed to divide jurisdiction over subordinate subprefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: In year 27 four circuit subprefects were appointed to divide control over the subordinate prefectures and counties.

translations.literal: They were divided under the Tongyong and Bachang circuits.
translations.idiomatic: They were assigned to the Tongyong and Bachang circuits.

translations.literal: And jointly placed under the overall authority of the Zhili governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: They were also placed under the overall supervision of the Zhili governor-general.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，復以部院大臣兼管府事，特簡，無定員。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng, again a ministry or court grandee was appointed to oversee prefectural affairs by special selection, with no fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yongzheng a ministry or court grandee was again specially appointed to oversee prefectural affairs, with no fixed number of posts.

translations.literal: In the ninth year, Ninghe was established.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 Ninghe county was created.

sentences.zh: 乾隆八年，遵化復升直隸州，以玉田、豐潤屬之。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Qianlong, Zunhua was again promoted to directly governed prefecture, with Yutian and Fengrun placed under it.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong year 8 Zunhua was again raised to a directly governed prefecture, with Yutian and Fengrun subordinated to it.

sentences.zh: 廣四百四十里，袤五百里。

translations.literal: It measures four hundred forty li in breadth and five hundred li in length.
translations.idiomatic: It spans 440 li east to west and 500 li north to south.

sentences.zh: 北極高三十九度五十五分。

translations.literal: North polar altitude: thirty-nine degrees fifty-five minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Its north polar altitude is 39°55′.

translations.literal: It governs five subprefectures and nineteen counties.
translations.idiomatic: It governs five subprefectures and nineteen counties.

sentences.zh: （遼，南京，今城西南，唐幽州籓鎮城也。

translations.literal: (Under the Liao, Nanjing; today southwest of the city—the Tang Youzhou frontier garrison city.
translations.idiomatic: (Under the Liao this was Nanjing; the site lies southwest of the present city—the Tang Youzhou frontier garrison town.

translations.literal: The Jin expanded it.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin enlarged it.

translations.literal: By the Yuan the old site was gradually buried.
translations.idiomatic: By the Yuan the old site had largely disappeared.

sentences.zh: 元之大都，則奄有今安定、德勝門外地。

translations.literal: The Yuan's Dadu then encompassed the area outside today's Anding and Desheng gates.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan Dadu, by contrast, covered the ground outside today's Anding and Desheng gates.

sentences.zh: 明初縮城之北面，元制亦改。

translations.literal: In the early Ming the north side of the city was contracted and Yuan institutions were also changed.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Ming the northern wall was pulled in and Yuan arrangements were revised.

sentences.zh: 永樂初，重拓南城，又非復洪武之故矣。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yongle the southern city was expanded again, no longer as in the Hongwu period.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Yongle the southern city was expanded again, so that it no longer matched the Hongwu layout.

translations.literal: Today the Imperial City measures eighteen li in circumference.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial City today measures eighteen li around.

sentences.zh: 自正陽門之內曰大清門；

translations.literal: Inside the Zhengyang Gate is the Daqing Gate;
translations.idiomatic: Inside the Zhengyang Gate stands the Daqing Gate;

translations.literal: southeast is the Chang'an Left Gate;
translations.idiomatic: to the southeast is the Chang'an Left Gate;

translations.literal: southwest is the Chang'an Right Gate;
translations.idiomatic: to the southwest is the Chang'an Right Gate;

translations.literal: east is the Dong'an Gate;
translations.idiomatic: to the east is the Dong'an Gate;

translations.literal: west is the Xi'an Gate;
translations.idiomatic: to the west is the Xi'an Gate;

sentences.zh: 正北曰地安門，舊曰北安門，順治九年更名。

translations.literal: due north is the Di'an Gate, formerly called the Bei'an Gate, renamed in the ninth year of Shunzhi.
translations.idiomatic: due north is the Di'an Gate, formerly the Bei'an Gate, renamed in Shunzhi year 9.

sentences.zh: 大清門之內曰天安門，舊曰承天門，順治八年改。

translations.literal: Inside the Daqing Gate is the Tian'an Gate, formerly called the Chengtian Gate, changed in the eighth year of Shunzhi.
translations.idiomatic: Inside the Daqing Gate is the Tian'an Gate, formerly the Chengtian Gate, renamed in Shunzhi year 8.

translations.literal: To the left is the Imperial Ancestral Temple; to the right the Altar of Land and Grain.
translations.idiomatic: On the left stands the Imperial Ancestral Temple; on the right the Altar of Land and Grain.

translations.literal: Facing the light to govern, here one dwells at the center.
translations.idiomatic: Facing the dawn to rule, the sovereign dwells here at the center of the realm.

sentences.zh: 其內端門，左闕左門，右闕右門。

translations.literal: Within is the Duan Gate; to the left the Left Que Gate, to the right the Right Que Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Within lies the Duan Gate, with the Left Que Gate on the left and the Right Que Gate on the right.

translations.literal: Within lies the Forbidden City.
translations.idiomatic: Inside stands the Forbidden City.

sentences.zh: 北枕景山，西衽西苑，苑有瀛臺，太液池環之。

translations.literal: North rests against Jingshan; west adjoins the Western Park; in the park is Yingtai, encircled by the Taiye Pool.
translations.idiomatic: It backs on Jingshan to the north and adjoins the Western Park on the west; within the park Yingtai is ringed by the Taiye Pool.

translations.literal: South, connected with the Duan Gate, is the Wu Gate.
translations.idiomatic: To the south, linked with the Duan Gate, is the Wu Gate.

sentences.zh: 北神武門，東東華門，西西華門。

translations.literal: North is the Shenwu Gate; east the Donghua Gate; west the Xihua Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On the north is the Shenwu Gate, on the east the Donghua Gate, and on the west the Xihua Gate.

sentences.zh: 午門之內，東協和門，東出為文華殿；

translations.literal: Inside the Wu Gate, east is the Xiehe Gate; eastward leads to the Wenhua Hall;
translations.idiomatic: Inside the Wu Gate, on the east is the Xiehe Gate, which opens east to the Wenhua Hall;

sentences.zh: 西熙和門，西出為武英殿，舊曰雍和門，乾隆元年更名。

translations.literal: west is the Xihe Gate; westward leads to the Wuying Hall, formerly called the Yonghe Gate, renamed in the first year of Qianlong.
translations.idiomatic: on the west is the Xihe Gate, which opens west to the Wuying Hall—formerly the Yonghe Gate, renamed in Qianlong year 1.

sentences.zh: 其正中太和門，左昭德門、體仁閣，右貞度門、宏義閣；

translations.literal: At the center is the Taihe Gate; to the left the Zhaode Gate and Tiren Pavilion; to the right the Zhendu Gate and Hongyi Pavilion;
translations.idiomatic: At the center stands the Taihe Gate; on the left are the Zhaode Gate and Tiren Pavilion; on the right the Zhendu Gate and Hongyi Pavilion;

sentences.zh: 其內則太和、中和、保和三殿，至乾清門止。

translations.literal: Within are the Taihe, Zhonghe, and Baohe halls, extending to the Qianqing Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Within lie the Taihe, Zhonghe, and Baohe halls, up to the Qianqing Gate.

translations.literal: East is the Jingyun Gate; west is the Longzong Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On the east is the Jingyun Gate; on the west the Longzong Gate.

translations.literal: All these are called the Outer Court, by regulation.
translations.idiomatic: All of this constitutes the Outer Court, by established regulation.

sentences.zh: 外則京城，周四十里，為門九：南為正陽門，南之東崇文門，南之西宣武門，東之南朝陽門，東之北東直門，西之南阜成門，西之北西直門，北之東安定門，北之西德勝門。

translations.literal: Outside is the capital city, forty li in circumference, with nine gates: south is the Zhengyang Gate; southeast of south the Chongwen Gate; southwest of south the Xuanwu Gate; southeast of east the Chaoyang Gate; northeast of east the Dongzhi Gate; southwest of west the Fucheng Gate; northwest of west the Xizhi Gate; northeast of north the Anding Gate; northwest of north the Desheng Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Outside lies the capital city, forty li around, with nine gates: the Zhengyang Gate to the south; the Chongwen Gate southeast of it; the Xuanwu Gate southwest; the Chaoyang Gate southeast of the east side; the Dongzhi Gate northeast of the east side; the Fucheng Gate southwest of the west side; the Xizhi Gate northwest of the west side; the Anding Gate northeast of the north side; and the Desheng Gate northwest of the north side.

translations.literal: All follow Ming practice.
translations.idiomatic: All follow the Ming layout.

sentences.zh: 而八旗所居：鑲黃，安定門內；

translations.literal: The residences of the Eight Banners: Bordered Yellow, inside Anding Gate;
translations.idiomatic: The Eight Banners were quartered as follows: Bordered Yellow inside Anding Gate;

translations.literal: Plain Yellow, inside Desheng Gate;
translations.idiomatic: Plain Yellow inside Desheng Gate;

translations.literal: Plain White, inside Dongzhi Gate;
translations.idiomatic: Plain White inside Dongzhi Gate;

translations.literal: Bordered White, inside Chaoyang Gate;
translations.idiomatic: Bordered White inside Chaoyang Gate;

translations.literal: Plain Red, inside Xizhi Gate;
translations.idiomatic: Plain Red inside Xizhi Gate;

translations.literal: Bordered Red, inside Fucheng Gate;
translations.idiomatic: Bordered Red inside Fucheng Gate;

translations.literal: Plain Blue, inside Chongwen Gate;
translations.idiomatic: Plain Blue inside Chongwen Gate;

translations.literal: Bordered Blue, inside Xuanwu Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Bordered Blue inside Xuanwu Gate.
